## Summary

Beijing Xiaomi Mobile Software Co., Ltd. was established in May 2012 with Wang Chuan as its legal representative, and its registered business scope includes basic and application software services, technology development and computer system services, per corporate-registry data reported by IT Home [1]. The IEEE registry lists 70 MA-L blocks to it, 68 at the Rainbow City Office Building, 68 Qinghe Middle Street, and two at the Xiaomi Campus on Xi'erqi Middle Road, both in Haidian District, Beijing; the larger set of Xiaomi blocks is registered to "Xiaomi Communications Co Ltd", which has its own entry [2]. The group, Xiaomi Corporation, was founded in Beijing in 2010 and sells smartphones under the Xiaomi, Redmi and POCO brands plus IoT and smart home devices, wearables and TVs [3].

No source consulted ties a specific product, radio or chipset to a block in this registrant's name, so a MAC here is most likely some Xiaomi-branded device, but which kind is unknown [2][3]. The security notes are about Xiaomi devices and apps in general, not this entity: Lithuania's 2021 censorship claim, which Xiaomi denied, and the 2025 Citizen Lab finding of weak encryption in Mi Store apps [3]. FCC grantee codes are not listed because the FCC ID databases refused requests from the session that wrote this entry.
